description: This file contains classes and functions for loading and processing the Omniglot dataset, including dataset downloading, class indexing, and N-shot learning batch generation.

classes.name: Omniglot
classes.description: Dataset class for loading Omniglot images, handling download, class indexing, and item retrieval.

classes.name: OmniglotNShot
classes.description: Class for generating N-shot learning tasks from the Omniglot dataset, including data caching, normalization, and batch sampling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for Omniglot class, initializes dataset, handles download if needed, and indexes classes.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves an image and its class label by index.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the dataset.

methods.name: _check_exists
methods.description: Checks if the processed dataset files exist.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads and extracts the dataset zip files.

methods.name: find_classes
methods.description: Finds all image files and their categories in the dataset directory.

methods.name: index_classes
methods.description: Creates a mapping from class labels to indices.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for OmniglotNShot, loads dataset, prepares data for N-shot tasks.

methods.name: normalization
methods.description: Normalizes dataset images to zero mean and unit std.

methods.name: load_data_cache
methods.description: Prepares batches of support and query sets for meta-learning episodes.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of data for training or testing.
